shared_elements: horizontal band of repeating geometric pattern (zigzag/lattice, step-fret)
block-like glyph or plaque units set in a row
justification: Both surfaces use dense low-relief ornament combining a row of block-like glyph/plaque units, plume- or scroll-like curved fronds, a schematically splayed hand, and a border band of repeating geometric pattern (zigzag/lattice in B, a step-fret band at the base of A), which is a fairly specific shared vocabulary. The decisive difference is the overall subject: A is dominated by a single frontal standing figure in elaborate costume occupying the whole field, whereas B has no figure at all, only a horizontal frieze of repeated abstract and emblematic motifs.
